baseSerializer.description:
If provided, the serializer whose #serializeValue and #deserializeValue will be used.
If not provided, the default serializer will be used (c3.GenaiCore.Serializer.Default(withDefaults=True))

serializerType.description: Serializer to use, DILL (has a dependency on the dill library) or JSON

title:
The default implementation of {@link GenaiCore.SessionStore.Serializer}.
This implementation uses:
  * `toTypedJson` and `fromTypedJson` for serialization and deserialization of {@link Serializable} C3 values.
  * {@link PythonSerialization} for all `native` values.

**NOTE** In order to make ser/deser as fast as possible for the most common use-case, this implementation
does **NOT** recursively inspect values for C3 instances within native objects/collections or vice versa.
This means that if you have a C3 instance within a native object or non-primitive native value (e.g. pandas
DataFrame), as a field on a C3 instance, you must use a different serializer that does recursive inspection.
name: GenaiCore.SessionStore.Serializer.Default
